question: Megger is a portable instrument to measure:
solution:
The correct answer is __High Insulation Resistance Value__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A Megger is used to measure high insulation resistance in electrical systems.
 
• It is a portable instrument that helps ensure the safety and efficiency of electrical circuits.
 
• The device works by applying a high voltage to check the resistance of insulation materials.
 
• Commonly used in industries like power generation, manufacturing, and construction.
 
• Helps in preventing electrical failures and ensuring compliance with safety standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inductance Value:**
 
 
• Measured using devices like LCR meters.
 
• Indicates the ability of a coil to store energy in the form of a magnetic field.
 
 
 
• **Power:**
 
 
• Measured using power meters or wattmeters.
 
• Represents the rate of energy consumption or generation.
 
 
 
• **Capacitance Value:**
 
 
• Measured using capacitance meters or LCR meters.
 
• Indicates the ability of a system to store electrical charge.
